_comment: An AI-generated theme for meeting musical instruments: each piece (about 45 s) puts one instrument in front and shows what it can do. The featured instrument is alone at the start and always on top. Every piece must keep moving: each section brings a new melodic phrase (never the same few notes again), the harmony progresses, the key modulates at least once (for unpitched percussion: new drums, techniques, grooves and tempos instead), and accompanying instruments are added as it goes, then it returns home for the ending. Generate with generate.py.
name: ✨ Meet the Instruments 🎶
attribution: Music generated with [Eleven Music](https://elevenlabs.io/music) by ElevenLabs.

defaults.style: Instrumental only, no vocals. A short showcase piece for children: one featured instrument clearly in front, recorded close and warm. Always developing: new melodic phrases in every section, moving chord progressions, key changes, more accompanying instruments joining as it goes. Clean, gentle, not harsh. End with a clear ending, no fade.
negative_styles: featured instrument buried in the mix

songs.title: The Drums
songs.prompt: A rock-concert drum solo for children: a short rock band intro, then the band stops and the drummer plays a wild, ever-changing solo all around the kit: heavy kick and snare, racing tom rolls, thundering double bass drum and cymbals, a sudden quiet part with whispers on the hi-hat and rims, a fast build-up, then the band crashes back in for a big ending. Never the same beat twice.

sections.name: Band intro
sections.cue: a short, happy rock band intro: electric guitar riff, bass and drums in E major, ending on a big stop with a cymbal crash

sections.name: Solo 1: kick and snare
sections.cue: the band stops; the drummer alone: slow heavy kick and snare calling and answering each other, loud rimshots, cheeky pauses

sections.name: Solo 2: around the toms
sections.cue: something new: fast rolls racing around the toms, from the high toms down to the thundering floor tom, then back up

sections.name: Solo 3: double kick and cymbals
sections.cue: something new again: thundering double bass drum underneath, crash and china cymbals exploding on top, ping-ping on the ride bell

sections.name: Solo 4: quiet trick
sections.cue: suddenly very quiet: whispering hi-hat ticks, stick clicks, rim taps and soft ghost notes on the snare

sections.name: Solo 5: build-up
sections.cue: a snare roll starts soft and grows louder and faster, toms and cymbals join, the whole kit builds to a huge peak

sections.name: Band returns
sections.cue: the band crashes back in, now in A major: guitar and bass play big chords while the drummer fills every gap, then three final hits together and a long cymbal crash
